structure: Single high-school course document (U.S. History). Pages 2-4: context/purpose, C3 and historical thinking skills, acknowledgments (backup). Page 5 onward: one table; row 1 = Learning Outcome for the course; then domain heading rows (Domains 1-7, chronological periods 1775 to present); each standard is a row with C1 = code (USH.d.n) and C2 = standard text; '(E)' marks essential standards. No examples or teacher notes.
